# pdf pangea

> Free PDF tools that run 100% in the browser. Files are never uploaded; works offline. Open-source libraries only.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/merge-pdf.html): Merge PDF online for free: combine PDF files into one document in seconds. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark – runs in your browser.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/compress-pdf.html): Compress PDF online: shrink PDF file size with your own DPI and quality, and see the estimated size before you start. Private, free, no upload.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfpangea.com/pdf-to-jpg.html): Convert PDF to JPG or PNG online for free. Choose 96–300 dpi, download every page as an image or as one ZIP. No upload – 100% in your browser.
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/jpg-to-pdf.html): Convert JPG, PNG and other images to PDF online for free. Combine photos into one PDF in your browser – no upload, no sign-up, no watermark.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/split-pdf.html): Split PDF online for free: cut a PDF into separate files by page ranges, every N pages or one file per page. Private, in your browser, no upload.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/rotate-pdf.html): Rotate PDF pages online for free: turn all or selected pages 90°, 180° or 270° and save permanently. No upload – runs in your browser.
- [Remove pages](https://pdfpangea.com/remove-pages.html): Remove pages from a PDF online for free. Delete unwanted pages by number or range in seconds – private, no upload, runs in your browser.
- [Extract pages](https://pdfpangea.com/extract-pages.html): Extract pages from a PDF online for free: keep only the pages you need as a new PDF. Private, no upload, works in your browser.
- [Organize PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/organize-pdf.html): Organize PDF online for free: reorder, rotate and delete pages visually with thumbnails. No upload – everything happens in your browser.
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/sign-pdf.html): Sign PDF online for free: draw your signature with mouse, finger or stylus and place it on any pages. No upload, no account – private, in your browser.
- [Add watermark](https://pdfpangea.com/watermark-pdf.html): Add a watermark to PDF online for free: stamp custom text with size, colour and opacity on every page. Private, in your browser, no upload.
- [Page numbers](https://pdfpangea.com/add-page-numbers.html): Add page numbers to PDF online for free: choose position, format and starting number. No upload, no sign-up – runs in your browser.
- [PDF to text](https://pdfpangea.com/pdf-to-text.html): Convert PDF to text online for free: extract all readable text from a PDF as a .txt file. Private, in your browser, no upload.
- [PDF to GIF](https://pdfpangea.com/pdf-to-gif.html): Convert PDF to animated GIF online for free: turn pages into a looping GIF with your own speed and size. No upload, runs in your browser.
- [GIF to PDF](https://pdfpangea.com/gif-to-pdf.html): Convert GIF to PDF online for free: put GIF images or animation frames into a PDF. Private, no upload, runs in your browser.
